intent: Unblock every push: the pre-push ci-mirror was failing on test_music_parallelism.sh, whose worktree drift guard still assumed the pre-flattening layout.
scope: linux_configuration/tests/test_music_parallelism.sh - derive the lib prefix instead of hardcoding it
Non-goal: music_parallelism.sh itself, which is correct - it sources ../../lib/common.sh, matching where lib/ actually sits after the flattening.
changes: The guard hardcoded ../lib/common.sh while the script sources ../../lib/common.sh. The flattening that moved the script from scripts/periodic_background/... up to periodic_background/... changed its depth, so the test failed on a layout that is in fact correct.
